hooks.name: Check Synthetics Health
hooks.description: Manually-invokable hook that checks whether the Synthetics canaries report the Maze Game Platform as healthy, via the CloudWatch Application Signals MCP tools. Also fires when a prompt mentions synthetics/canaries/app health.

action.prompt: Activate the "synthetics-health" skill and run it: check the Maze Game Platform CloudWatch Synthetics canaries (maze-platform-readonly and maze-platform-fullflow, region us-east-1) via the CloudWatch Application Signals MCP tools (list_canaries, and analyze_canary_failures for any failing canary). Report a one-line healthy/unhealthy verdict first, then each canary's last-run status and time, and for any failure the failing step and probable cause. Read-only; do not modify resources.
